concepts.gloss_en: when a person has faith (general condition of possessing emunah; here the cure for sadness/laziness rooted in lack of faith)

members.note: representative; generic possession of faith in lm1:155

concepts.gloss_en: when a person has such faith (a specific elevated kind of emunah that spreads through all the limbs, per lm1:91) — not generic faith

members.note: 'כזו' points to a particular grade of faith described in the Torah, not faith in general

notes: The demonstrative כזו narrows to a specific type of faith (that pervades all limbs) discussed in lm1:91, whereas כשיש לו אמונה is the general condition. Different referents — kept separate per under-merge preference.
